sourceName: FIFA.com and FIFA Digital Hub World Cup 2026 match schedule PDF
verifiedBy: Codex RM8 manual encoding from official FIFA schedule PDF, with UTC timestamp conversion cross-checks
notes: Official group/team data, group-stage match IDs, venues, dates, and Eastern Time kick-off times are encoded from the FIFA World Cup 2026 match schedule PDF dated 10 April 2026.
